name: Forsaken
desc:
[ CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS AND LOUD AUDIO, IT IS RECOMMENDED TO NOT PLAY IF YOU'RE EPILEPTIC ]

Welcome to your eternal prison. 

SURVIVORS: Protect your teammates, complete the objectives, and survive until the timer hits 0.
KILLERS: Kill them all, leave no one left standing. Do whatever it takes.

Once you decide to enter, you won't be able to go back. This is your home now. Forever forsaken by it all.

🏆 RIA 2025 Best Survival Experience
